suggestions.suggestion: Choose a documented source for market lines before any strategy is judged.
suggestions.why: G0 (provenance) fails for every strategy until this is decided.

options.label: License a documented odds feed
options.tradeoff: Cost and a licence check are needed; best evidence quality.

options.label: Keep nfldata with a disclosure
options.tradeoff: Free and reproducible, but provenance and licence are unknown (Q02, Q13).

options.label: Drop market comparison
options.tradeoff: Study the model only; no betting conclusion possible.

suggestions.suggestion: Pre-register a short list of hypotheses before running more tests.
suggestions.why: Ten strategies were tested; the Bonferroni threshold is already strict (p < 0.005).

options.label: Pre-register 3 hypotheses
options.tradeoff: Lowest false-discovery risk; slower to find anything.

options.label: Keep the current 10 with Bonferroni
options.tradeoff: Already applied; fine for a screen, weaker for new ideas.

options.label: Add many more variants
options.tradeoff: Raises the chance of a lucky result; not recommended.

suggestions.suggestion: Widen the injury signal so it has enough games to test.
suggestions.why: Only 7 games qualify for the QB Out/Doubtful signal (Q04).

options.label: Include Questionable and practice status
options.tradeoff: More games; weaker signal per game.

options.label: Use team counts by position group
options.tradeoff: Broader; needs a rule for which groups matter.

options.label: Pause injury strategies
options.tradeoff: Keeps the leaderboard honest until data exists.

suggestions.why: The brief asks for rewards; the definition is not yet set (Q07).

options.label: Points only, shown on the leaderboard
options.tradeoff: No money involved; simplest and lowest legal risk.

options.label: Points plus a public ranking history
options.tradeoff: Adds accountability over time.

options.label: Monetary reward
options.tradeoff: Not recommended: wagering from Singapore is restricted (Q01).

suggestions.suggestion: Start archiving depth-chart snapshots so a history exists.
suggestions.why: Historical depth data is not week-keyed (Q05).

options.label: Archive snapshots by CI from now on
options.tradeoff: Builds history at no cost; no past data.

options.label: Find an official weekly depth source
options.tradeoff: Best evidence; the search has not been done yet.

options.label: Drop depth-based signals
options.tradeoff: Focus on the official injury report only.

suggestions.suggestion: Choose how often the data refreshes.
suggestions.why: Injury reports change through the week; the site is static.

options.label: Weekly CI refresh
options.tradeoff: Current; needs a scheduled workflow.

options.label: Refresh on demand only
options.tradeoff: Lowest maintenance; may be stale.

options.label: Freeze at the current snapshot
options.tradeoff: Stable for review; no new information.

suggestions.suggestion: Add features the market may not price, one at a time, each pre-registered.
suggestions.why: The model is currently 0.4 points worse than the market (Q10).

options.label: Rest and travel
options.tradeoff: Data exists in the games file; effect likely small.

options.label: Keep the model simple
options.tradeoff: Less overfitting; serves as a benchmark only.

options.label: Stop model development
options.tradeoff: Focus on verification and data quality.

suggestions.suggestion: Build a CI job that reconciles every row against the official NFL pages.
suggestions.why: Only 3 games and 9 injury rows have been checked (Q08, Q14).

options.label: Full reconciliation in CI
options.tradeoff: Strongest evidence; more CI time.

options.label: Sample-based checks each week
options.tradeoff: Cheaper; leaves gaps.

options.label: Keep manual spot checks
options.tradeoff: Lowest effort; weakest evidence.

suggestions.suggestion: Clean up stale 'in progress' rows on the coordination board.
suggestions.why: Irregularity R1 on Flagged for review.

options.label: Owner confirms closure and the agent updates rows
options.tradeoff: Accurate board; needs one owner decision.

options.label: Leave as is
options.tradeoff: No work; board stays confusing.

suggestions.suggestion: Show the Singapore legal position and help line on every page.
suggestions.why: Participating in unlicensed gambling is an offence; problem gambling needs a visible route to help.

options.label: Keep the current banner and footer
options.tradeoff: Already in place.

options.label: Add the NCPG help link to the landing page
options.tradeoff: Clearer; the NCPG link was taken from the GRA page and not fetched.
